'''Morena''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Chareen]] [[Aiel]].

==History==
Morena served as Wise One for [[Erim]], Clan chief of the Chareen Aiel.<ref>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Morena</ref> 

[[Sulin]] thinks she has a great deal of influence with Elin.<ref>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Erim</ref> 

This character is only mentioned in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]] and does not seem to appear or be mentioned in the main series.
